subject: Purchase ID trace + line-item merge action
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Moreno <l.moreno@seaviewops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Purchase ID trace + line-item merge action

Hi Lucas / Seaview team,

Thanks for submitting the onboarding forms this morning. I reviewed the packet and there are three operational gaps preventing us from creating a clean purchase record on our side:

1) No Redwood purchase-id was issued after your vendor intake (we see the vendor intake form but no mapped purchase record in our ledger).
2) The submitted line items in the Seaview CSV appear duplicated (lines 4–7 repeat the same SKU with different quantities).
3) Your requested spend cap ($120,000) exceeds the standard onboarding cap (currently capped at $75,000) and needs procurement approval.

Can you confirm the vendor's internal request number (if you have an internal PO: e.g., SV-PO-####)? Also please attach the native line-item CSV (we can accept an updated one) — I've attached our onboarding checklist and a sample mapping CSV to show the column naming we require.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
- You: Send back a clean line_item CSV with duplicate rows removed and a single requested spend cap per bundle (deadline: EOD Aug 13).
- Redwood (Monica/Karthik): Create a provisional purchase-id and map to your internal SV-PO if provided; propose a temporary spend cap increase to $100k while we reconcile.
- Both: Reconvene on Aug 14 to finalize final PO issuance and ledger mapping.

Attachments: redwood_onboard_checklist.xlsx (attached), sample_mapping_template.csv (attached).

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so we can avoid delays in provisioning.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Lucas Moreno <l.moreno@seaviewops.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Seaview Ops Billing <procure@seaviewops.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase ID trace + line-item merge action

Thanks Stephanie — quick reply from our side.

We do have an internal request ID: SV-PO-2026-312. That was included in our intake form but looks like the column header was "internal_ref" and may not have mapped into your system. Apologies for the confusion.

I've attached: 
- seaview_po_form_v2.pdf (native PDF intake)
- vendor_invoice_stub.csv (contains the same line items as the onboarding CSV)

Two notes on the line items:
- Lines 4–7 are correct on our end: they represent a staged delivery where quantity is split by fulfillment window. If Redwood's ledger needs them as a single consolidated row, we can provide a merged view.
- Spend cap: our procurement policy requires the $120k cap for this first tranche. If you must provision with a temporary cap lower than that, we can split into two tranches, but prefer a single capped allocation to avoid extra invoices.

Suggested action: If you can provision a provisional Redwood purchase-id and link SV-PO-2026-312 to it (even with a provisional spend cap of $100k) we can proceed with initial provisioning; we'll follow up with a final consolidated CSV to match your ledger expectations.

Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

—Lucas
Lucas Moreno
Head of Operations, Seaview Operations
l.moreno@seaviewops.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-13T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase ID trace + line-item merge action

On Thu, Aug 12, 2026 at 11:05 AM Lucas Moreno <l.moreno@seaviewops.com> wrote:
> We do have an internal request ID: SV-PO-2026-312. That was included in our intake form but looks like the column header was "internal_ref" and may not have mapped into your system.

Thanks for the context, Lucas — that helps. Internal note for procurement and ops below.

Monica — please create a provisional Redwood purchase-id in the format RWD-PO-YYYY-XXXX and map the external SV-PO-2026-312 to it as an external_reference. For speed, set a provisional spend cap of $100,000 for the first tranche. I'll submit an expedited approval for the remaining $20k to reach their requested $120k if Seaview provides the consolidated CSV by EOD Aug 13.

Checklist for the internal action:
- [ ] Create RWD provisional purchase-id and tag external_reference=SV-PO-2026-312 (deadline: 2026-08-13 2:00pm PT).
- [ ] In the ledger, mark lines 4–7 as "staged_delivery" so we preserve vendor semantics, but add a consolidated line for our billing aggregation (we'll keep both rows for now).
- [ ] Upload mapping file to PROC-1234 (Jira) and drive folder linked in thread.

Rationale: preserving the staged rows prevents a mismatch with Seaview's shipments while our finance team validates the consolidated billing view. If we later need to collapse the lines for accounting, we'll do a reconciliatory journal entry rather than re-issuing new purchase-ids.

I will also ping finance for a quick sign-off on the temporary cap.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Lucas — quick confirmation from my side:

- Monica has created provisional purchase-id RWD-PO-2026-4417 and tagged external_reference=SV-PO-2026-312. (See attached mapping CSV: line_item_fix_proposal.csv)
- Ledger will preserve staged_delivery rows (4–7) and will also include a consolidated billing row for aggregation.
- Procurement approved a provisional spend cap of $100,000 for initial provisioning; remaining $20,000 will be considered after we receive a consolidated CSV from Seaview.

Please confirm you received the mapping CSV and that RWD-PO-2026-4417 maps to your internal process. Once you confirm, Monica will kick off provisioning and we will send the final PO issuance notification.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
